title: 第11章 你的对手是我第12章 危险级别 ★★★★★★★★★★
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 陆远真是差点儿被赵巧儿气懵。
你不想活了，你想死，那你早说啊！
自己这折腾半天，差点儿把命都搭进去，现在说让自己跑了？
那自己之前折腾半天是图啥呢？
图你长得美，还是图你腚大？
之前陆远还好声好气的哄赵巧儿，又是什么大美姨，又是什么大美人的。
现在陆远可绷不住了。
这生死存亡的时候，胡闹什么呢！
而此时的赵巧儿也完全懵了。
趴在地上，一只涂着鲜红指甲油的粉嫩玉手捂着自己的丰腴大腚，满脸愕然与羞愤。
毕竟在赵巧儿视角里，自己这可是放弃了自己的生命，换陆远活下去。
结果……
结果陆远没领自己情不说……还……当着漫天遍野的邪祟面前，打自己腚……
“赶紧上来！！”
陆远瞪着赵巧儿，大声呵斥着！
一时间，赵巧儿也不知道是咋想的，可能是陆远那两巴掌真是给赵巧儿打懵了。
赵巧儿竟像是个受委屈的小姑娘一般，抽了抽鼻子，手脚并用地爬起来，慌不迭地重新趴到陆远背上。
那委屈又不敢言的小模样，活像是生怕自己慢了一秒，陆远会再赏她两巴掌。
温香软玉的厚重感再次压上脊背。
陆远二话不说，双臂如铁钳，再次牢牢锁住赵巧儿那丰腴修长的大白腿。
他想起了观里那爱喝大酒的老头子说过的话。
娘们就得揍，不听话就揍，揍一顿比说一百句好话都管用。
陆远虽然不能完全苟同，但不得不说……
在一些特定的环境下，给两巴掌，确实比其他的方式要更快。
抓稳赵巧儿的瞬间，陆远牙关猛地一咬，整个人如炮弹般悍然冲出！
周遭是密不透风的邪祟鬼影。
然而，当那些扭曲的黑影即将触碰到他的瞬间，便被陆远周身爆开的璀璨金光狠狠弹开！
砰！砰！砰！
沉闷的撞击声不绝于耳。
陆远就好像地球上的国道大运一样。
给这些邪祟直接撞翻！！
就连那六星吊死鬼和五星伥鬼，试图上前阻拦，也被他身上那层霸道的金光撞得倒飞出数米远，鬼体一阵虚幻。
陆远就这么在万鬼丛中，硬生生撞出一条通路！
趴在他背上的赵巧儿，看着眼前这神威赫赫的一幕，彻底看傻了。
她没想到，这看似随时会熄灭的金光，竟如此霸道绝伦！
狂喜涌上心头，可她旋即又想到了陆远的体力……
说实话，陆远现在真的是强弩之末了。
只能说幸好幸好现在是下山。
虽然有句俗话说的好，上山容易下山难。
但就陆远现在的情况，在来一次上山，那真是想都别想，根本不可能。
唯独这下山，还能凭着一股惯性再冲一次！
特别是现在邪祟都甩在身后了，前面一个邪祟都没有，陆远一阵突突突，下的速度极快！
下山最难的地方在于重心不好控制，脚一个踏空，就容易匆匆忙忙连滚带爬的滚下山去。
content_en:
Lu Yuan was almost stunned by Zhao Qiaoer.
If you don’t want to live anymore, if you want to die, you should have said it earlier!
I have been struggling for a long time and almost lost my life, and now I want to let myself run away?
Then what was the point of all the fussing about for a long time?
Do you want to be beautiful, or do you want to have a big butt?
Before, Lu Yuan was coaxing Zhao Qiao'er in a good-tempered manner, what kind of beautiful aunt and what kind of beauty was she?
Lu Yuan couldn't hold himself any longer now.
At this time of life and death, what are you talking about?
At this time, Zhao Qiaoer was also completely confused.
Lying on the ground, a pink hand painted with bright red nail polish was covering her plump butt, with a face full of shock, shame and anger.
After all, from Zhao Qiaoer's perspective, he was giving up his own life in exchange for Lu Yuan's survival.
The result...
In the end, Lu Yuan didn't admit his love to him...and...he slapped himself in the butt in front of the evil spirits all over the sky...
"Hurry up!!"
"Come up quickly!!"
Lu Yuan glared at Zhao Qiaoer and yelled loudly!
For a moment, Zhao Qiaoer didn't know what he was thinking. Maybe Lu Yuan's two slaps really stunned Zhao Qiaoer.
Zhao Qiaoer sniffed like a wronged little girl, got up on her hands and knees, and hurriedly lay on Lu Yuan's back again.
She looked aggrieved and afraid to speak, as if she was afraid that if she was slow for a second, Lu Yuan would slap her twice.
The heavy feeling of warm fragrant nephrite pressed down on my spine again.
Without saying a word, Lu Yuan used his arms like iron pliers to lock Zhao Qiaoer's plump and slender white legs once again.
He remembered what the old man in the temple who loved to drink a lot said.
Women must be beaten, if they don't obey, a beating will be more effective than a hundred nice words.
Although Lu Yuan couldn't completely agree, he had to say...
In some specific circumstances, giving two slaps is indeed faster than other methods.
The moment he caught Zhao Qiao'er firmly, Lu Yuan gritted his teeth and rushed out like a cannonball!
The surroundings are airtight and full of evil ghosts.
However, the moment those twisted black shadows were about to touch him, they were severely bounced away by the bright golden light that exploded around Lu Yuan!
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The dull crashing sound was endless.
Lu Yuan is like the great fortune of the country on earth.
Knocked over by these evil spirits! !
Even the six-star hanged ghost and the five-star ghost ghost tried to stop him, but they were knocked backwards several meters away by the overbearing golden light on his body, and their ghost bodies became illusive.
Lu Yuan just forced his way through the crowd of ghosts!
Zhao Qiaoer, who was lying on his back, was completely dumbfounded when he saw the majestic scene in front of him.
She didn't expect that this golden light that seemed to be extinguished at any time would be so overbearing!
Ecstasy surged into her heart, but she immediately thought of Lu Yuan's physical strength...
To be honest, Lu Yuan is really at the end of his strength now.
All I can say is that luckily we are going downhill now.
Although there is a well-known saying, it is easier to go up the mountain than to go down the mountain.
But given Lu Yuan's current situation, it was impossible to even think about going up the mountain.
Only this time down the mountain, I can rush again with a sense of inertia!
Especially now that all the evil spirits are behind him, and there is not a single evil spirit in front of him, Lu Yuan suddenly bursts out, falling at an extremely fast speed!
The most difficult part of going down the mountain is that it is difficult to control the center of gravity. If one foot is missing, it is easy to roll down the mountain in a hurry.
